full_judgment: 10. The relevant facts in Writ Petition No. 2078 of 2011 inter-alia is that the petitioner was the owner of the land comprising an area of 17 decimals of land of Plot No.601 and 874 of S.A. Khatian No. 297 corresponding to R.S. Khatian No.335 and 296/1 of Mouza Pushi, Police Station-Rupganj, District-Narayanganj. The land of the petitioner and other lands of the area were acquired by the Government in L.A. Case No.20/1993-94. At the time of making requisition and acquisition of the said land, the authority concerned prepared compensation assessment and after such assessment an award of Tk. 43,170/- was paid to the petitioner. Subsequently, RAJUK invited application from interested persons for allotment of plots in the concerned project of Purbachal Residential Area. The petitioner after due compliance of all necessary formalities submitted an application for obtaining a plot against the said land as an affected person, but the respondents did not allot any plot to the petitioner as affected person. The petitioner issued representation to get the said plot for allotment but in vain. The RAJUK during acquisition of the land of the petitioners and others had made a declaration that the affected persons, whose land has been acquired by the Respondents would receive the benefit of preferential treatment relating to allotment of land in the said area and would be allotted a compensatory plot in the Purbachal Residential Area and which was published in National dailies, but the respondents did not allot any land to them.
